Poet,Ⓒs.ⒹkaviH, sUriH; ‘a ready p(oet)’ SIGra-kaviH.
Ⓝ[Poet]ic, [Poet]ical,Ⓒa.ⒹEx. by kavitA-kAvya in comp.; ‘p(oetic) genius’ kavitvaSaktiH.
Ⓑ
 2 Sloka-kavitA-rUpa-badDa, padyamaya (yI f.), CaMdobadDa-rUpa, padyAtmaka; ‘p(oetic) work’ padyA-tmako graMTaH.
Ⓝ[Poet]ically,Ⓒadv.ⒹpadyarUpeRa, CaMdo-rUpeRa.
ⓃPoetics,Ⓒs.ⒹkAvyaSAstraM, padyaSAstraM; sAhityaM.
ⓃPoetry,Ⓒs.ⒹkAvyaM, kavitA.
Ⓑ
 2 padyaM (opp. of prose).
Ⓑ
 3 kAvyaracanA, kavitvaM, kavitAvidyA.
ⓃPoetaster,Ⓒs.ⒹkukaviH, kavideSyaH.
ⓃPoem,Ⓒs.ⒹkAvyaM, kAvyaprabaMDaH, kAvyabaMDaH, kavitA; ‘a p(oem) interspersed with prose’ KaMqakAvyaM.
ⓃPoesy,ⒶkavitvaM-tA.
Ⓑ
 2 kAvyaracanA, kavitASakti f.
